header.description: List filters: FilterWeapons, FilterArmour, FilterSundry, FilterInvenItems, FilterAll
notes: Each case runs frmMain's own Filter* procedures (cut out by tools/oracle/frm.py) against the stock database. The lists (lvWeapons, lvArmour, lvOtherItems) are recording ListViews read before the sort that follows: 'number' or 'number:tag' per row in the order MME added it (weapon tag = attack kind; martial-arts rows are 0 with tags -1..-3, the surprise punch 0 with tag 4). 'full' holds whole weapon rows. 'equip' is the ItemData of each cmbEquip(0..19) entry (entry 0 is '(none)').

Controls not named by a case have MME's ResetFilterOptions defaults (the family-wide forms). Characters are the pipeline scenario's: RefreshAll runs first. Cases without one set the global filter's controls by hand. bOnlyInGame is true unless a case says otherwise. msgbox lists the answers to MME's MsgBox calls in order (6 yes, 7 no, 2 cancel).

Stubbed: LV_RefreshSort / LV_Sort_ColumnClick and the *_ItemClick handlers (UI after the list is built), FilterSpells and cmbGlobalClass_Click (FilterAll's other callees, P3-30 and the UI), ExpandCombo and the picture loads.
data holds every item with the fields the filters read (weapons and armour in full); the spells, classes, races, names and textblocks the weapon rows need are the rows fixture's data.
